--- title: Opt-in families description: IBM Plex Mono and Unbounded stay off the standard bundle until a project asks for them. sidebar: icon: sparkles order: 4 --- The standard stylesheet stays focused on Makira and Paper Mono. These two families are fully hosted, but each has its own CSS file. ## IBM Plex Mono A quieter optional mono for technical labels, code, and dense metadata. Normal and italic, 100–700. ```html ``` ```css .meta { font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 500; } ```
IBM Plex Mono / 700

IBM Plex Mono

status: ready · GET /tree.json

:::note Paper Mono remains the standard code face. Reach for IBM Plex Mono when a surface wants a less expressive mono, especially if italic is required. ::: ## Unbounded Wide geometric display cuts, plus a variable family across 100–900. Also includes the Blond cut. ```html ``` ```css .display { font-family: "Unbounded", "Makira", sans-serif; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } ```
